newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar falls below 114 yen in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Dollar falls below 114 yen in Tokyo.

text.p: The dollar fell below 114 yen in Tokyo on Tuesday, its lowest level since late December 1996, pushed lower by increasing speculation that the U.S. Federal Reserve will leave interest rates unchanged when its policy arm meets later in the day.

The greenback began sliding in morning Tokyo trade on U.S. fund and interbank sales that then snowballed, setting off consecutive waves off stop-loss selling that quickly took the greenback lower, dealers said.
By mid-morning, the dollar had briefly fallen as low as 113.85 yen, its lowest level since late December 1996, although it subsequently recovered slightly on short-covering, dealers said.
